summaries.summary: The extension is a legitimate client for a local AI server (FastFlowLM). It uses standard VS Code APIs to register a language model provider, manage a local server process via child_process (as documented in the README), and provide a chat interface via a webview. All network traffic is directed to a user-configured local endpoint. The static scanner hits are false positives resulting from standard chat UI patterns and local server communication. There are no signs of malicious intent, credential harvesting, or unauthorized data exfiltration.

findings.description: The static scanner flagged a 'keylogger' pattern due to a keydown event listener. Upon review, this listener is strictly bound to the 'Enter' key combined with Ctrl/Meta to submit a chat message in the webview. It does not capture arbitrary keystrokes, buffer input, or exfiltrate data. This is standard UI behavior for a chat interface.

The static scanner flagged 'data exfiltration' due to POST requests. These requests are sent to a user-configured local server URL (default 127.0.0.1:8000) to interact with the FastFlowLM AI model. This is the core advertised functionality of the extension and not malicious exfiltration.
The static scanner flagged a hardcoded IP address. The IP 127.0.0.1 is the loopback address, used as the default for a local server connection. This is benign and expected for a local tool.
